Subject: Exec briefing: pre-read sprint and presenter slate

Team —

Goal: finalise presenter roster and lock the pre-read booklet for the Acme executive workshop (Wed/Thu next week). I sketched a minimal run-of-show and a short sprint plan so we can ship the briefing book by EOD Thurs. Key asks below: 

- Confirm presenters for the three breakout sections (Product strategy, Cost/ops, Security/compliance). We only need names + 2-sentence speaker intent.
- Pull or create 1-page pre-reads for each session (one slide or 300–400 words). Target: consolidated PDF for attendees.
- Compile presenter bios in one spreadsheet (title, headshot link, 2-line bio, talk length).

I've attached a Day1 run-of-show (draft) and an initial presenter_bios.xlsx with placeholders. Vanessa: can you take lead on coordinating voiceover notes for the Product strategy session? Soojin: can you own the pre-read consolidation and deck export? Marissa: help with speaker copy and bios.

Timeline (fast):
- Tue EOD: confirm presenter names and intents
- Wed AM: final drafts of pre-reads into Drive folder
- Thurs EOD: export and lock briefing_book_v1 for print/email

I'll loop in Acme to confirm their internal attendees and any last-minute constraints. Short sync tomorrow 9:30am if that helps.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of GTM Programs, Redwood Inference
